title: Korymon
description: A modpack blending Pokémon, advanced technology, and breathtaking exploration into one epic adventure
body:
Embark on an adventure where Pokémon, technology, and exploration come together! This modpack blends the best of Cobblemon with cutting-edge advancements from Oritech, alongside breathtaking world generation from Terralith and Tectonic. Whether you're a Pokémon trainer, a tech enthusiast, or an explorer at heart, there's something for everyone!

## Features
- Cobblemon – Catch, train, and battle Pokémon in a seamless open-world experience.
- Oritech – Upgrade yourself with powerful cybernetic implants and cutting-edge technology.
- Terralith & Tectonic – Explore a world full of stunning new biomes, towering mountains, and lush landscapes.
- Immersive Exploration – Discover new structures, dungeons, and hidden secrets.
- Automation & Machinery – Enhance your survival with advanced machines and automation.
- Expanded Building & Decoration – New blocks, furniture, and aesthetic options to build your dream base.
- Quality of Life Enhancements – Performance optimizations, better UI, improved inventory management, and more!
- Multiplayer Friendly – Designed for both solo and server play, so you can enjoy with friends!

Are you ready to become the ultimate Pokémon trainer, tech genius, and master explorer?
